cra.title: Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) · vulnerability reporting
cra.description: From 11 September 2026, if you sell a product with software in the EU, every actively exploited vulnerability in it must be reported through ENISA's single reporting platform (to the coordinating CSIRT and to ENISA): an early warning within 24 h, a notification within 72 h and a final report 14 days after a fix is available. Here you see those deadlines for your products; active exploitation comes from the CISA KEV catalog.

events.no_products: First, mark which repositories or images are products under the CRA.
events.not_scanned: Your products don't have a completed full scan yet; without one there's no way to know whether anything needs reporting.
events.none_in_kev: None of the vulnerabilities in your scanned products is in the CISA KEV catalog. This is checked on every scan.

products.title: Products under the CRA
products.not_scanned: No completed full scan yet: run one to find out whether anything needs reporting.
products.scan_first: Scan a repository or an image first.
products.admin_only: Only an admin can mark products and record notifications.
products.name: Product name (as marketed)

event.candidate: Scanner candidate: confirm it affects the product before you report it.

stage.waiting: Starts once a fix is available
